messages:
devin: All-hands live thread — feel free to drop emojis and snack recs! :sparkles:
maya: clapping so loud my dog woke up :clap: :dog:
oliver: lol same. mic drop was iconic.
jamie: Can we get a polka-dot confetti gif? Asking for a friend :polkadot: (not a real emoji)
lucy: i brought actual confetti to my screen. very technical
ben: :partyparrot: partyparrot for the new infra wins
devin: shoutout @sana for the performance charts — they were 🔥
sana: aww thanks! team did all the work :heart:
all-hands-bot: Q&A ends in 5 minutes — submit via /q
oliver: mini poll: best post-all-hands fuel? 1) iced coffee 2) pastry 3) protein bar
maya: 2 for pastry :croissant:
jamie: 1 and 3 tie, we need an IRL taste test
lucy: who's bringing pastries to SF office tomorrow? @ben
ben: guilty. bringing bagels and something gluten-free
devin: recording link pls so I can rewatch the demo
sana: will post in #docs, ETA 10m
lucy: also — big thanks to the new hires who did demos, especially @eli!
eli: thanks! heart pounding but fun :sweat_smile:
oliver: gif: tiny frog in a tux (attached) :frog:
jamie: :clap::clap: :thumbsup:
devin: ending with a quick riddle: what has keys but can't open doors? (no cheating in chat)
maya: piano
devin: correct! prize: one imaginary confetti cannon
all-hands-bot: reaction summary: :clap: x24, :sparkles: x12, :heart: x8
jamie: :raised_hands: that was fun. next all-hands theme: cosplay?
lucy: yes please, I will wear a cape
ben: cape party in #random afterwards :cape:
sana: thanks everyone, logging off now :)
eli: bye all! 🫶
